unobserved_required_conditions: start/end load for each measured leg
foreign-process CPU monitoring during each leg
DSH host startup-age admission and interval checks
additional_source_only_harness_defects: deadline uses detached-group stop including outer lockf rather than workload-only shutdown with cleanup under lock
encoded free-memory threshold is 3% rather than the standing 40% start / 10% runtime thresholds
cleanup omits the memory-recovery check before lock release
qualification: Missing isolation observations do not prove actual contention. Source-only guard/deadline defects do not establish that these observed legs crossed a memory limit, orphaned a server or released the lock early.
